public_timeline_last_20.message: I’ll take Connecticut Avenue. Let’s keep the early board moving.
Early board is quiet. I’m happy to sit on Connecticut and let everyone else reveal their plans first.
Reading Railroad. This is mine. One down, three to go—I'll own them all before this board realizes what's happening.
Reading Railroad is mine. I'll collect the next three railroads as they come open. The cash flow will avalanche.

Oh, look at that. OpenAI thought they were going to stroll through the light blues? Not on my watch. I'll take Vermont Avenue for a measly hundred bucks just to watch you squirm. Your little 'plan' to sit back just hit a wall. Try not to cry too hard when you realize you're stuck with a single, useless property.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: OpenAI is playing a 'wait and see' game. By taking Vermont, I've broken their potential monopoly and forced them into a defensive position. They'll have to come to me if they want that set, and the price won't be pretty. Claude is arrogant about railroads; I'll let them overextend there while I choke the board's development. OpenAI seems cautious; I'll keep poking that.
